mechanics.summary: A weapon can be loaded only with ammunition of the correct caliber shown in the firearm listing’s Ammo column.

outcome.value: incompatible ammunition cannot load weapon

mechanics.summary: A firearm attack may add zero through its RoF number of ammo dice; modifiers do not affect ammo dice.

outcome.value: ammo dice count from 0 to RoF, unaffected by modifiers

mechanics.summary: A firearm attack using no ammo dice spends exactly one round.
trigger: firearm attack selects zero ammo dice

mechanics.summary: On a base-dice hit, each ammo-die success can add 1 damage or create an additional hit on the same target or a secondary target in the same hex.
trigger: firearm base dice hit and ammo dice show successes

outcome.value: spend each ammo success for +1 damage or additional hit

exceptions: A secondary target cannot be harder to hit directly than the primary target.
Each additional hit has base damage at random location, plus 1 damage for every further ammo success spent on it.

unknowns: Relative direct-hit difficulty requires rule-context input.

mechanics.summary: On a missed firearm attack, one or more ammo-die successes can still suppress the target.
trigger: firearm base dice miss and ammo dice show success

outcome.value: target makes suppression resolution

mechanics.summary: When pushing a firearm roll, reroll ammo dice not showing a success or bane; each bane on base or ammo dice, including initial-roll banes, reduces reliability by 1.

outcome.value: reroll eligible ammo dice; -1 reliability per counted bane

exceptions: A weapon breaking from pushing breaks after the current attack resolves.

mechanics.summary: Two or more banes on base or ammo dice after pushing jams the weapon after attack resolution; the attack’s successes and ammo effects still apply.
trigger: pushed firearm roll has at least 2 banes

outcome.value: weapon jammed after attack

exceptions: Reliability is also reduced.
A jammed weapon cannot fire until cleared.

mechanics.summary: Clearing a jam is a slow action requiring the weapon’s skill roll; multiple attempts are allowed.
inputs: Ranged Combat or Heavy Weapons roll

outcome.value: slow action attempts to remove jam

mechanics.summary: After an ammo-dice roll and reroll, ammunition spent equals the sum of the D6 digits on all ammo dice.

outcome.value: sum all ammo-die face values

exceptions: If spent amount exceeds remaining magazine rounds, the magazine is emptied.

mechanics.summary: Do not apply more ammo-die successes than rounds remaining in the magazine; remove superfluous successes first.
trigger: ammo-die successes exceed magazine rounds remaining

outcome.value: remove superfluous ammo successes before results

mechanics.summary: Reloading a firearm uses RANGED COMBAT: success makes it fast, failure makes it slow; the roll is not an action.
exceptions: A fast-action-only attempt that fails forfeits the action.

mechanics.summary: Heavy weapons do not use ammo dice and consume one ammunition round per attack.
Bows and thrown weapons use no ammo dice; each shot uses one arrow or one thrown weapon.
Recovering a projectile from a target requires slow action and MEDICAL AID; failure inflicts 1 damage on the victim. Recovering from ground in target hex after a miss is fast.
trigger: combatant recovers arrow or thrown weapon

mechanics.summary: Nocking an arrow is fast for a bow and slow for a crossbow; a prepared bow must only aim and shoot or it must be prepared again.

outcome.value: set or clear prepared state

exceptions: Crossbows are not subject to the prepared-bow action restriction.
Thrown weapons need no preparation and use MOBILITY.

mechanics.summary: Each point of pushing or external damage reduces gear reliability by 1; at zero the item is broken and unusable. If no reliability is listed, use 5.

outcome.value: reduce reliability; zero means broken

mechanics.summary: Repairing broken gear needs a shift, tools, TECH roll, and matching spare part; success consumes the part and restores reliability equal to successes, never above listed reliability.

outcome.value: consume part and set reliability to success count capped at listed value

exceptions: On failure, retry next shift.

mechanics.summary: Restoring unbroken reduced reliability takes a shift and TECH roll, needs no spare part, and adds 1 reliability per success up to listed value.

outcome.value: increase reliability by successes capped at listed value

mechanics.summary: In every week a firearm is used, spend a shift and succeed at TECH to service it or reliability drops one step.

outcome.value: on missed service, reliability -1

exceptions: The Referee can require gun care after extraordinary exposure such as water or mud.

unknowns: Weekly use and extraordinary exposure require tracking or Referee input.

mechanics.summary: Weapon tables define Type, Ammo, Rel, RoF, Damage, Crit, Blast, Range, Mag, Armor, Weight, and Price.
exceptions: A dash means no direct damage; melee weapons have no range and only work in same hex.

mechanics.summary: A telescopic sight gives +1 when aiming as a slow action, or +2 from a stable platform such as a rest, sandbag, or bipod.

unknowns: Whether a platform is stable is not defined here beyond examples.

mechanics.summary: A night-vision sight removes darkness restrictions and modifiers for firearm fire only within SHORT range.
trigger: firearm uses night-vision sight in darkness

outcome.value: remove darkness restrictions and modifiers within SHORT range

exceptions: Without infrared light, the sight sees at most two hexes.
Infrared light is visible to other night-vision devices.

mechanics.summary: A tripod is optional for general-purpose machineguns but required for heavier weapons unless fired from a vehicle mount.

outcome.value: heavier weapon requires tripod or vehicle mount

exceptions: General-purpose machinegun tripod use is optional.

unknowns: Weapon weight category and current mount require input.

mechanics.summary: Radio range doubles when vehicle-mounted or using a long-wire antenna, and can double for one shift with successful TECH.

outcome.value: double range for each printed qualifying condition

unknowns: Whether the printed doubling effects stack is not specified.

mechanics.summary: Binoculars give +2 to RECON only while actively scouting or observing.
trigger: active scouting or observation with binoculars

mechanics.summary: Powered night-vision goggles remove darkness modifiers to RANGED COMBAT and RECON to one hex, or two hexes with attached infrared light.

outcome.value: remove darkness modifiers within printed distance

exceptions: Attached light allows total darkness.

mechanics.summary: Thermal optics remove all visibility limits and skill modifiers from darkness, weather, and smoke.

outcome.value: remove listed visibility limits and skill modifiers

exceptions: Hot smoke or smoke with thermal chaff is excluded from the text’s see-through-smoke description.

mechanics.summary: A battery-powered flashlight removes darkness effects within one hex.

outcome.value: remove darkness effects within 1 hex

exceptions: It is very visible to others; infrared cover makes it visible only to night-vision devices.

mechanics.summary: A protective mask removes the -3 STAMINA modifier against chemical effects but gives -2 to RECON and STAMINA rolls for marching.
A properly worn hazmat/MOPP suit with protective mask fully protects against most chemical weapons and offers some radiation-contamination protection.

outcome.value: full protection against most chemical weapons

exceptions: Radiation protection is described only as some protection.

unknowns: The unspecified radiation degree cannot be automated.

mechanics.summary: Raingear gives +1 to STAMINA rolls to avoid chemical-weapon effects.
trigger: Stamina roll avoids chemical effect while wearing raingear

mechanics.summary: A personal medkit gives +1 to MEDICAL AID and is disposable after one use.
trigger: Medical Aid roll uses personal medkit
exceptions: Can be used only once.

mechanics.summary: A doctor’s medical kit gives +2 to MEDICAL AID.
trigger: Medical Aid roll uses doctor's medical kit

mechanics.summary: Surgical instruments give +1 to MEDICAL AID only when treating fatal critical injuries and can combine with medkits.
trigger: Medical Aid treats fatal critical injury with instruments
exceptions: Can combine with medkits.

mechanics.summary: A dose of antibiotics gives +3 to MEDICAL AID for infected wounds and other bacterial infections for one day.
trigger: Medical Aid treats bacterial infection using antibiotic dose
exceptions: Effect lasts one day.

mechanics.summary: A pain-reliever dose heals 1 damage in one stretch; further doses in the same shift have no effect.
exceptions: Further doses in same shift have no effect.

mechanics.summary: Weapon tools give +1 when repairing weapons.
trigger: TECH repairs weapon using weapon tools

mechanics.summary: A small still produces up to 5 liters of alcohol per shift of stationary use and needs 1 encumbrance unit of organic material per liter.
exceptions: A small still can be jury rigged using 20 general spare parts.

traits: Range is short range in 10-meter hexes
Melee weapons have no range and only work in same hex
referenceData.notes: Individual weapon model statistics are printed in tables on pp. 93-114 and are reserved for reference-tables-and-derived-values.
Armor application procedure is in combat-melee-grappling-and-damage.
